description: Polyperc 1 on channel 1 plays one melody at 90 BPM, velocity 80, built from two patterns assigned to the same channel with trig merge All and the pentatonic lock off, in C major. Pattern 1 has degrees 0, 2, 4, 2, 0 and 4 on steps 1, 3, 5, 7, 9 and 13; pattern 2 has degrees 2, 6, 3, 3, 0 and 5 on steps 1, 5, 9, 11, 13 and 15. Steps 1, 5, 9 and 13 are in both patterns, so the note merge mode decides them. Bars 1 and 2 use Average and play MIDI 62, 69, 64 and 64 there; bars 3 and 4 use Higher and play MIDI 65, 72, 69 and 71. Steps 3, 7, 11 and 15 belong to one pattern each and sound the same in both halves: MIDI 64, 64, 65 and 69. Listen for the shared steps jumping higher at bar 3, about 5.3 seconds in, while the in-between notes stay put.
synchronization: Observed framebuffer/grid sampled against host monotonic recording time; not sample-exact or physical-norns calibration.
title: Average, then Higher
